function.name: get_open_items
function.description: Retrieve open invoices and/or credit memos for the current patient.

Scenario.description: "D" = invoices + credit memos (default). "I" = invoices only. "C" = credit memos only.

maxDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) — latest document date filter.
